description: MCP server for Google Workspace — Sheets, Drive, Docs (HTML or Markdown), and Calendar.
name: io.github.khuisman/mcp-gee-sweet

environmentVariables.description: Pin a single auth method with no fallback, instead of the default waterfall (OAuth, then service account, then Application Default Credentials).
environmentVariables.name: AUTH_METHOD

environmentVariables.description: Path to an OAuth Client ID JSON file downloaded from GCP Console, used for the oauth auth method.
environmentVariables.name: CREDENTIALS_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Path where the OAuth token is cached after the first interactive authorization.
environmentVariables.name: TOKEN_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Path to a Google service account JSON key file, used for the service_account auth method.
environmentVariables.name: SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Base64-encoded service account JSON key, as an alternative to SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PATH for headless or container deployments.
environmentVariables.name: CREDENTIALS_CONFIG

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of tool function names to register. Default: all tools enabled.
environmentVariables.name: ENABLED_TOOLS
